topic: Skills: teach Claude a task once, and it does it your way every time
post:
Tired of giving Claude the same instructions every week? 🔁
Teach it once with a Skill.

A Skill is a saved set of instructions. Claude loads it on its own whenever your request matches what the Skill is for.

Anthropic's guide says a Skill pays off when you do a task often and want it done the same way every time. A weekly report format. A checklist. A multi-step routine.

How to make your first one 👇
1️⃣ Write your task in one sentence, plus what a good result looks like
2️⃣ Ask Claude to use the "skill-creator" skill to draft it with you
3️⃣ Turn it on in Customize > Skills
4️⃣ Try a real request and tweak the wording if Claude doesn't pick it up

Example sentence:
"Turn my meeting notes into a 5-bullet summary, then a list of action items with owners and due dates."

📌 Skills are available on Free, Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans, with code execution turned on. They work in chat, Cowork and Claude Code.

Why it matters:
You stop re-explaining yourself. Claude starts working the way you already do. 💡

What's one task you'd teach Claude once? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
